nodes.summary: Nontrivial endomorphisms of the braid commutator subgroup on five or more strands are automorphisms. For every $n > 4$, every endomorphism of the commutator subgroup $[B_n, B_n]$ of the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands other than the trivial endomorphism is bijective, that is, an automorphism.
nodes.title: Nontrivial endomorphisms of the braid commutator subgroup on five or more strands are automorphisms

nodes.summary: The statement that for every $n > 4$, every endomorphism of the commutator subgroup $[B_n, B_n]$ of the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands other than the trivial endomorphism is bijective, that is, an automorphism. Posed by V. Lin and V. Shpilrain.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.102(b): endomorphisms of the braid commutator subgroup

nodes.summary: The braid group `Bₙ` on `n` strands, by Artin's presentation.
nodes.title: Braid group on n strands

nodes.summary: The answer to Kourovka Problem 14.102(a) is negative: there is no $n > 4$ for which the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands has a non-injective endomorphism whose image is not cyclic. Equivalently, for every $n \ge 5$, every non-injective endomorphism of $B_n$ has cyclic image.
nodes.title: Non-injective endomorphisms of braid groups on five or more strands have cyclic image

nodes.summary: The statement that for some $n > 4$ the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands has a non-injective endomorphism whose image is not cyclic (in particular not trivial). Posed by V. Lin and V. Shpilrain.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.102(a): non-injective braid endomorphisms with non-cyclic image

nodes.summary: Artin's relators for the braid group on `n` strands, in the free group on the generators `σ₀, …, σ_{n-2}` (indexed by `Fin (n - 1)`): `σᵢ σⱼ = σⱼ σᵢ` when `j ≥ i + 2`, and `σᵢ σᵢ₊₁ σᵢ = σᵢ₊₁ σᵢ σᵢ₊₁`.
nodes.title: Artin's braid relators

nodes.summary: For every $n > 4$, the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands has a nontrivial normal subgroup $N$ such that the quotient $B_n / N$ is non-abelian and torsion-free (no element other than the identity has finite order).
nodes.title: Braid groups on five or more strands have proper non-abelian torsion-free quotients

nodes.summary: The statement that for every $n > 4$, the braid group $B_n$ on $n$ strands has a nontrivial normal subgroup $N$ such that the quotient $B_n / N$ is non-abelian and torsion-free (no element other than the identity has finite order). Posed by V. Lin and V. Shpilrain.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.102(c): torsion-free quotients of braid groups

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
